fitting_policy: Use the existing Stage 2 training-only bundle unchanged; no 2010-2018 refit or holdout adaptation.
sample_seed_rule: SeedSequence([42, 3, year, stream]); uniform eligible rows without replacement. Year metrics nest within profiles; pooled metrics nest within year metrics.
distance_definition: Euclidean distance to nearest frozen centroid in all three unwhitened PCs; thresholds computed only from the saved training sample. Distortion is squared distance.
bootstrap_seed_rule: SeedSequence([42, 3, year, 3, block_days]); all grid cells resampled jointly in non-circular consecutive-day blocks. Sample ceil(30/L) blocks from starts 0..30-L, then truncate to 30 days.
metric_geometry: training-standardized original three features; equivalent to retained unwhitened PCA geometry
failure_policy: Integrity/schema/protocol failures stop. Missing clusters or inadequate samples are reported as inconclusive/undefined rather than repaired by tuning. Report all prespecified endpoints; poor transfer is a result.
prior_exposure: Phase 1 explored 2010-2021, including feature availability/correlations. Holdout is reserved from Phase 2 fitting/tuning, not historically unseen.
